matching_rule: same predicted class as selected target_class AND highest IoU among same-class detections; valid if IoU >= 0.50
eligible_target_rule: eligible iff clean image has a valid target match (same class + IoU >= 0.50)
attack_success_definition: eligible AND patched image does NOT have a valid target match
confidence_drop_rule: mean/median confidence_drop only over eligible targets where BOTH clean and patched matches are valid; missed patched targets leave patched_confidence/iou empty (no invented values)
iou_drop_rule: mean IoU_drop only over eligible targets where BOTH clean and patched matches are valid
